doc.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

title: Hymn books, spirituals and the Singing River legend
summary: The men discuss jazz coming from church hymns and slavery-era singing, and Jim tells of the Singing River in Mississippi.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
